mainText: Hello, Verona! At 9 PM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 68 degrees with light drizzle at Reddan Soccer Park, and you can see a Waning Gibbous moon; overnight, the temperature will dip to 63 degrees with rain predicted.

A reminder that a portion of Highway M near the future Aldi site will be closed from October 6 to October 9 for final road work, so please follow the detours. Also, early voting for the November 3 election is available at City Hall with specific hours starting October 20.
There is plenty to do, including Hop Haus Trivia happening today, and tomorrow brings the Verona Downtown Farmer's Market and trivia at The Bogey Factory.
On September 21, police identified a suspect who committed retail theft of candy from a retailer on East Verona Avenue.
Today's flavor is the delicious Caramel Peanut Buttercup. We are currently open but will be closing in 45 minutes, so make sure to get there soon.
